blocks.en: Another useful property of the Fourier transform is that it turns convolutions into products and vice versa. We shall first consider test functions. It is easy to see that the product and convolution of functions in $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ are again in $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$. Their behavior under Fourier transform is given by the next lemma.
blocks.zh: Fourier 变换的另一个有用性质是, 它将卷积变为乘积, 反之亦然. 首先考虑试验函数. 容易看出, $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 中函数的乘积和卷积仍属于 $\mathcal{S}(\mathbb{R}^m)$. 下一引理给出它们在 Fourier 变换下的行为.

blocks.zh: 现在将这一结果推广到分布.

blocks.en: We note that $\mathcal{F}[g]$ is a $C^\infty$ function with polynomial growth (see Example~\ref{ex:fourier-compact-distribution-entire} above) and therefore the right-hand side of \eqref{eq:fourier-convolution-compact-distribution-product} is well defined. A similar result can be established for tempered distributions on $\mathbb{R}$ whose supports are bounded from the same side; see Problem~\ref{ex:one-sided-tempered-fourier-product}.
blocks.zh: 注意, $\mathcal{F}[g]$ 是具有多项式增长的 $C^\infty$ 函数 (见上面的 Example~\ref{ex:fourier-compact-distribution-entire}), 因而 \eqref{eq:fourier-convolution-compact-distribution-product} 的右端有良好定义. 对 $\mathbb{R}$ 上支集在同一侧有界的缓增分布也可建立类似结果; 见 Problem~\ref{ex:one-sided-tempered-fourier-product}.
